title: DeepSwap review: pricing, credits, API and alternatives
summary: DeepSwap review covering photo, GIF and video face swap, current credit costs, HD access, API availability, limitations, and alternatives.
body_markdown:
## Quick answer


**DeepSwap suits longer video face swaps, but budget in rounded 15-second blocks.**


A 16-second clip costs two credits; a 30-minute clip needs 120. Full Access includes 20 credits, with annual access allocating 20 per month. Compare the actual checkout charge, additional credits and accepted exports before buying. Magic Hour fits face swaps that continue into broader video, image and audio workflows.


This vendor-authored review was checked against[DeepSwap official product and policy pages](https://www.deepswap.ai/) on September 20, 2026. Magic Hour publishes this guide and is included as an alternative. It is a documentation review, not a retained cross-tool quality benchmark.


## What is DeepSwap?


DeepSwap is an AI face-swap product for replacing a face in an image or video. Published unit costs for photo, GIF and video swaps plus API access. Use only media you own or have permission to edit, and obtain explicit consent from every identifiable person.


*DeepSwap official product page, captured September 25, 2026. Any sample outputs or performance statements visible here are the vendor’s examples and claims, not our independent test results.*[View official source](https://www.deepswap.ai/)


## What DeepSwap does well


Credit-metered video face swaps with long-video and multitasking options. Its workflow removes much of the manual masking and compositing required by conventional editing. That convenience does not prove every output is accurate: inspect eyes, teeth, hairlines, skin edges, occlusion, lighting and identity across the full clip.


## DeepSwap pricing and access


DeepSwap’s current pricing page lists video face swap at one credit per 15 seconds, photo face swap at 0.1 credit and GIF face swap at one credit. Full Access includes 20 credits; annual access supplies 20 each month, or 240 across the year. Benefits include HD face swap, priority processing, multitasking and videos up to 30 minutes. Check the actual purchase screen for the access charge and any additional credit pack.


## How many DeepSwap credits will your clips use?


The[official FAQ](https://www.deepswap.ai/faqs) rounds every partial 15 seconds up to a full credit. For ordinary video face swap, calculate credits per billable attempt as ceiling(clip seconds ÷ 15).

These are arithmetic examples, not measured output quality. Twelve separate 15-second clips need 12 credits; twelve 16-second clips need 24. A 20-credit balance covers at most five minutes in complete 15-second blocks before retries. The 30-minute upload ceiling is a file limit, not an included allowance.


For a dollar budget, record the checkout access charge plus extra credit purchases, then divide by accepted exports. Keep unused credits separate from credits consumed. A rejected but completed output still belongs in your attempt budget unless the service confirms a refund.


The[API center](https://www.deepswap.ai/api-center) says API credit usage follows website rules and API credits can be purchased online. Full API documentation requires a web login. Confirm your API account balance and purchase terms rather than assuming a web subscription covers every integration cost.


## Privacy, consent and commercial use


Face media is sensitive. Review DeepSwap’s current privacy and terms pages in the purchase flow before uploading client or confidential material, and preserve consent and source-rights records for every identifiable person.


A commercial-use label does not clear publicity, copyright, trademark or contractual rights. Keep written consent, source licenses and disclosure records. Never use face swap to impersonate, deceive, harass or create intimate imagery without consent.

## How to test DeepSwap fairly


Use one permitted portrait, one difficult side angle and one short motion clip. Keep resolution, duration and source files constant. Record attempts, processing time, charged credits, watermarks, export resolution and whether the output was usable without manual repair.


Reject outputs with identity drift, unstable jaw or hair boundaries, flicker, incorrect occlusion, changed expression, altered skin tone or artifacts around glasses and hands. Compare cost per accepted output rather than cost per generation.


## Recover failed jobs and save the finished export


DeepSwap’s FAQ says generation failures are automatically refunded; verify this in Credits history before rebuying. A poor completed result is different from a failed task. If one person appears in several detected-face selections, the FAQ advises selecting every instance belonging to that person.


The same FAQ gives uploads a 30-day inactivity period, reset by another swap, and creations a one-week storage period. Download accepted results promptly. Treat the service as a processing workspace and keep a separate delivery archive.


## Verdict


DeepSwap has a defensible place for credit-metered video face swaps with long-video and multitasking options. Full access and credit packs must be combined to estimate real production cost. Test one representative job and verify current policies before committing sensitive media or recurring production.
